articles.title: Kraken Feeling Connected As New Season Opens

away.summary: The Seattle Kraken are starting their sixth season with a projected lineup that includes several young, emerging players. Despite the absence of injured forward Mackie Samoskevich, the team feels more united than ever, with a focus on consistency and teamwork.

out.detail: injured (hip), will start season on injured reserve

home.summary: The Calgary Flames are entering their 2026-27 season with a mix of veterans and young talent, including a new leadership group led by Mikael Backlund. Despite the absence of injured forward Jonathan Huberdeau, the team is focused on building on their previous season's performance and adapting to the new arena environment.
